response.justification: Bogdan is a capable software engineer with solid fundamentals in craftsmanship and some distributed-systems experience, but he does not meet critical CTO requirements. The role demands 5+ years of senior technical leadership scaling teams to 30+; his resume shows only individual contributor and early-career senior roles with no evidence of team management or organizational scaling. Production multi-agent AI systems are essential—he has only ~4 months of agentic-framework exposure at re:cinq, insufficient for leading architectural decisions at this level. Equally concerning, he lacks fintech and regulated-environment experience despite the role's focus on compliance-heavy algorithmic trading. He would be a strong senior engineer *on* the team, not its technical leader.
strengths: Demonstrable software craftsmanship with consistent focus on TDD, CI/CD, and clean-code practices across multiple domains and languages
Hands-on distributed-systems and high-throughput infrastructure experience (Dunnhumby: millions of HTTP requests/sec, real-time metadata handling with low-latency patterns)
Active, recent engagement with agentic AI tooling and MCP frameworks at re:cinq, showing current technical awareness in the AI space
concerns: Zero evidence of engineering leadership or team scaling; all roles are individual-contributor or junior-leadership levels—role requires proven ability to scale from 10 to 30+ engineers
Only ~4 months of production agentic-AI exposure (recent), nowhere near the deep, multi-year track record needed to architect and operate multi-agent systems at scale
No fintech infrastructure, regulated-environment, or high-stakes financial systems experience despite brief RIDE Capital role; credit systems, payment flows, and compliance are core to the position
